lede: One Wikipedia article ran away with the day: Christa Pike drew 4,309,025 views, about 8.7 times the runner-up, and not one of the other sixteen feeds offers a reason why. Beneath that spike the real crossover stories are quieter. The 2026 Asian Games medal table is climbing on both Wikipedia and Google Trends, and a lawsuit over the death of Renee Good is being shared on both Bluesky and Lemmy.

throughlines.title: 2026 Asian Games medal table
throughlines.gist: The 2026 Asian Games medal table, and India's slide down it, is drawing readers on Wikipedia and searchers on Google at the same time, the strongest shared thread in today's snapshot.

throughlines.title: Family of Renee Good sues US government and Trump officials over her death | CNN
throughlines.gist: A CNN report that Renee Good's family is suing the US government and Trump officials over her death is circulating on both Bluesky and Lemmy, a story living almost entirely in the social feeds.

throughlines.title: China Open: Yue Yuan vs Mirra Andreeva
throughlines.gist: A China Open match between Yue Yuan and Mirra Andreeva is both a Google search spike and an active Polymarket contract, the day's one crossover between search and betting.
